warmup_time_s.description: Data loading phase - IO bound (disk dependent)

certificate.description: Benchmark report expires after this many days

warmup_slow: 1. Disk change or degradation (HDD vs SSD)
tickrun_slow: Possible causes for slow tick processing:

stability.description: Maximum spread across the raw runs of ticks_per_second. Above this the instrument cannot resolve a code regression, so the median means nothing. Calibrated from the committed reports: worst historical spread 13.0% (1.2.1); the invalid 2026-08-24 runs were 20.2% and 34.4%.

summary_generation_time_s.description: Report DERIVE + PERSIST across the scenario set, once per batch. Was 0.12s through 1.2.x and is ~3.4s since the unified reporting pipeline (#391-#403) — accepted cost. The ceiling exists so the NEXT growth of that size cannot hide in an untoleranced INFO metric.

config_contract.description: The configuration the reference baseline was measured under. Deliberately minimal — only the three families that move a CPU-bound throughput number: process fan-out, profiling overhead, and log volume. Each entry is a dotted path into the EFFECTIVE (merged) app config, so a user_configs/app_config.json override that reaches one of them is caught rather than measured. Changing a value here is a deliberate act: it re-defines what the reference means, so re-measure the baseline in the same step.
